Not done: A decision read can show a fix's title
Gate: decision heading and plain test output pane proofs

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a plain test run writes a 5 MiB log. This writer lets the log grow, but register.ts:156-160 reads the entire file through `$.fs.read`. The [pinned Claude Code API](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/v2.1.322/mods/types/claude-code.d.ts#L2677-L2691) rejects reads over 4 MiB, so the pane catches the rejection and says there is no output. The 32 MiB ruling did not account for this lower API limit; logs between 4 and 32 MiB still fail to open.
findings.title: Not done: Some plain test rows still have no usable output

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a pull request runs the repository's test checks without a globally installed Claude executable. `pane_draws` skips both real-data pane tests in that environment. The PR test job in .github/workflows/forge.yml:58-89 does not install Claude; the separate job that installs it in .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:65-74 does not run this test file. A green PR check therefore does not prove either behavior through the pane. Even when run locally, tests/fixtures/pane-real-data.test.ts:23-24 replaces `fs.read` with a fake and the generated log is only about 1.5 MiB, so the proof passes despite the real API rejecting a 5 MiB log.
findings.title: Gate: decision heading and plain test output pane proofs

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round: a true line with the file's path for output over 4 MB, and the test file in the CI job that has Claude Code

why: The pane shows the previous session's rows with their age when a new session's first read fails, shows a decision by its file name, and has no output to open for a plain test run.
